Happy Birthday, Hira ❤️‍🩹

♡ ───────── ♡

Janma dinko dherai dherai suvakamana 🎂❤️

Sadhai timile socheko kura haru pura hos,
timro face ma yo smile sadhai rahos,
ani timro life ma khusi ko kami kahile nahos. 🥹❤️

Timi sadhai khusi rahanu,
timro harek din ramro hos,
ra timile chaheko harek kura pura hos. 🤍

Kahile kahi life ma sabai kura hamile soche jasto hudaina…
tara timro muskan chai kahile pani na haros. ❤️‍🩹

Timro aankha ma sapana haru sadhai jiwit rahun,
ani timro mutu ma khusi kahile pani kam nahos. 🥹❤️

Jasle timilai sachchai bujhcha,
timro feelings ko value garcha,
ra timilai sadhai special feel garaos—
testo maya timro life ma sadhai rahos. 🤍

Ra yedi kahile din haru garo bhaye pani…
“Yo pani bitcha” bhanera feri smile garna saknu. 🌷

Aaja ko din timro lagi matra ho…
tei bhayera aaja dherai khusi hunu,
dherai hasnu,
ani yo birthday lai ramro memory banaunu. 🎂💗
